items.line: Direct at 5° Scorpio on Nov 13.|It re-crosses 21° Scorpio on Nov 30.

caption:
Why Mercury retrograde looks backward, and what Vedic astrology says. ☿

Mercury passes between Earth and the Sun, so it seems to slide back against the stars. Vedic astrology calls this vakri, and reads a retrograde planet as stronger, not weaker.
